items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And he was first influenced by Miff Mole on the trombone.

ctx.x: What kind of musical background did he have?

Oh he came from Boulder, Colorado and went to the, I guess, the University of Colorado. And that's where he met his wife, Helen. And he was a bandsman. He was a bandsman. He was not a very good improvisor, a good jazz musician. And he was first influenced by Miff Mole on the trombone. But he was an excellent musician. A great arranger and he played his horn very well. I mean he played legitimate things
beautifully. A good reader, good execution. Great facility on his instrument. Good tone and I think a dedicated musician you know.
